column1: # Suggested replacements for 1.12.2 API names that are gone on 1.21.4.
# Suggestions only: check each one; some need a data-type change too. Names that exist on both versions are
# preferred where they exist (e.g. ItemMeta#setUnbreakable). ShowScript helpers from issue #31 work on both.

column3: BLOCK (data must be BlockData, e.g. Material.X.createBlockData(); MaterialData no longer works)
FALLING_DUST (data must be BlockData, not MaterialData)
DUST (needs new Particle.DustOptions(Color, size) as data)
PLAYER_HEAD (data 3), SKELETON_SKULL (0), WITHER_SKELETON_SKULL (1), ZOMBIE_HEAD (2), CREEPER_HEAD (4), DRAGON_HEAD (5)
